decision.observation: The goose stands before the closed wooden gate; the metal latch pipe hangs on the right post high up (~0.755,0.28). The boot lies on the path's right edge. The bend hint persists as an overlay.
decision.hypothesis: The groundskeeper beyond the gate opens it when he hears honks, but he may be wandering at the garden's far end; repeated honks spaced by waits should catch him when he is in earshot.
decision.memory: Sequence: honk, wait 3s, honk, wait 3s, honk, then wait and watch the gate.
